post.description: Verify a Play Integrity token for the current device. If an active cached token exists, backend reuses it. If no cached token exists or the cached token is expired, backend verifies the token with Google Play Integrity and saves a new 30-day cache entry. This endpoint does not count an ad view and does not require a reward session. Null or empty integrity_token is accepted as a bypass response.

parameters.name: x-device-id
parameters.description: Device ID used to bind and cache the Play Integrity token

integrity_token.description: Opaque Play Integrity token from Android. Send null or omit to receive a bypass response.

post.description: Submit one rewarded-ad completion for an existing reward session. This endpoint only increments ads_watched and updates the session to ready when ads_required is reached. It does not accept or verify an integrity token.

get.description: Lấy popup hiện tại cho app. BE tự tính slot gần nhất theo UTC dựa trên slot_time đang được cấu hình trong DB/CMS. Manual active được ưu tiên trước auto; nếu auto chưa có thì BE tự random template và tạo record. Auto popup sẽ random title/description từ lockscreen_auto_texts enabled; nếu không có item enabled thì title/description rỗng.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Supported country code from SUPPORTED_COUNTRIES, e.g. vn. Optional.

country_code.description: Country code for this popup record. null means global/all.

parameters.name: scheduled_date
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country code filter, e.g. vn. Use all or omit this query to show every record. Use global to show records where country_code is null.

post.description: CMS tạo popup manual hoặc auto theo date/slot. Không lưu button_text và không lưu image_url; app lấy ảnh từ template.image_url. Với auto, title/description có thể rỗng để app tự xử lý text.

slot_time.description: UTC time in HH:mm or HH:mm:ss format

title.description: Bắt buộc khi mode=manual; có thể rỗng khi mode=auto

description.description: Bắt buộc khi mode=manual; có thể rỗng khi mode=auto

country_code.description: Optional country code. null/omitted/all means global.

slot_time.description: UTC time in HH:mm or HH:mm:ss format

country_code.description: Optional country code. null/all means global.
